target.text: George reported that the lobby coffee machine stopped mid-brew and shows an unfamiliar error code. Facilities asked him to photograph the display so maintenance can order parts.

The second-floor printer jams whenever a duplex job runs, and the display freezes until the front panel is opened. Ms. Peru from accounting reproduced the fault twice and left sample sheets with the technician, who suspects a worn roller.

The warehouse badge reader at loading dock two has been rejecting valid cards since Monday evening, forcing drivers to sign in on the paper clipboard and slowing every shipment. Security reset the device twice, but the fault returns within an hour, so the vendor asked for a full event log. The case is now escalated on behalf of Yanirys.

Both east-wing escalators stopped between floors yesterday, stranding staff on the mezzanine for twenty minutes. Building services requested an urgent inspection quote.
Regards,
Di Cerbo

Babica cannot log into the lab scheduling portal after the password policy change, and every attempt locks the account for fifteen minutes. The lab manager confirmed the account exists and suggested a ticket so the desk can verify identity and reset credentials properly.

The conference room projector keeps dropping the HDMI signal every few minutes, which ruins client demonstrations and has already interrupted two sales calls this week. Mr. Nelsan from the audiovisual team borrowed a replacement cable and tested different ports, yet the fault persists, so he now believes the input board itself needs a warranty repair.
The rooftop HVAC unit vibrates loudly at night and wakes residents on upper floors. The property team logged a noise complaint and scheduled a technician visit for Rukmon.

Delivery bay three lost power to its electric shutter, so parcels stack up outside whenever the wind picks up. The facilities desk asked for an electrician assessment before Friday stock intake.
Kind regards,
Ferella

Alimatou noticed the parking gate arm reacts slowly to valid stickers, sometimes closing on vehicles that have not fully passed the sensor line. Because two colleagues reported near misses this month, security extended the opening delay temporarily, but the underlying sensor drift remains, so a certified technician should recalibrate the loop detector before someone damages a mirror.
The shared drive disconnects whenever the backup starts, so afternoon edits vanish unless people save locally. Ms. Usée asked the helpdesk to move backups to midnight.

The kitchen extraction fan trips its breaker daily, and cooking smells linger into the next morning. Housekeeping cleaned the filters, which helped for a week before the fault returned. The building manager wants the motor checked during the next visit by Hierzer.

Since the software update the customer display at till six shows stale totals, which confuses shoppers who already paid and triggers repeated refunds. The store team reproduced the issue with three test baskets, photographed every mismatched receipt, and escalated the case with a request for rollback guidance before the weekend rush.
Sincerely,
Bernardeta
Kirupakara called twice about the broken doorbell unit, which buzzes at random hours even when nobody presses it. The electrician will inspect the transformer on Thursday.

The elevator in the annex skips the fourth floor whenever more than six people board, forcing everyone to climb the last flight with boxes. Mr. Gesto reported the pattern after three separate trips, and the maintenance firm now wants a load test.

The archive room dehumidifier failed during the heat wave, and the librarian found buckled spines on two reference shelves the next morning. Recovery specialists froze the worst volumes to stabilize the bindings, while portable units now hold thirty percent humidity. Insurance wants photographs, purchase dates, and a written loss estimate for the claim, prepared overnight by van Bree.

Ms. Wittstock, the invoice for March consultancy still lists forty hours instead of the agreed twenty-five, so the finance team paused payment pending a corrected version. Could your office resend the document with the updated breakdown and the revised total?

We are drafting next term's activity schedule and noticed the gymnastics hall is double-booked on Thursday afternoons. The head coach offered the small studio, but that would split the group. After the office manager explained the clash to Taekwondo, both clubs agreed to share the first hour and rotate equipment between groups so nobody loses a session.
The summer newsletter exceeded its mailing budget by a third, because of the printed inserts nobody reads. Finance proposes digital-only distribution from August, subject to approval by Marevci.

Attached is the corrected workshop roster with the Thursday slot moved to the morning, as requested during last week's call. Please confirm the room booking covers both projectors, because the demo needs a second screen for the live prototype.
Cheers,
Faretti

Mr. Alcides, following our site visit last Tuesday, the engineering team finished the structural report you requested. The balcony slab shows hairline cracks consistent with age rather than overload, and the drainage channels need clearing before winter. We recommend a follow-up inspection in spring, when the sealant can be renewed under drier conditions. The full report is attached.
The pottery course sold out within an hour, and the waiting list holds thirty names. Aneta suggested a second evening group if the kiln schedule allows.

The supplier switched packaging suppliers without notice, and half the delivered boxes arrive crushed along the seams. The warehouse team repacked what could be saved and documented the damage with photographs. A complaint letter went out this morning, drafted and signed by Abdelmoula.

Thank you for the detailed notes from the budget review. I updated the forecast with the revised travel figures and the corrected licenses, then shared the workbook with attendees. Two items need answers from finance: the conference deposit and the maintenance contract. Once those land, the file can be locked and archived with the minutes.
Best regards,
Reguel
Ms. Mukthar, your library card expires next week and two titles are waiting at the front desk. Please collect them before Saturday or the holds return to the shelves.

The volunteer schedule for the food bank has gaps on the early shifts, especially Tuesdays when the delivery van arrives before sunrise. Moinas offered to cover two mornings if someone else handles the inventory computer, so the coordinator is redrawing the rota.

The translation agency delivered the report in three languages, but the Portuguese version swaps two chapter numbers and repeats a caption from last year. Proofreading caught the errors before printing, and the agency acknowledged the mistakes within an hour and offered a discount. The corrected files arrived this morning and passed a second review by Lília Schrutt.

The park run starts at nine on Sunday, and the volunteer tent needs someone for the water table. Bring gloves, because the bins were not emptied.
Best,
Cassotti

Mr. Aiden, the community garden plot assignments are ready at the seed library this week. Bring the receipt from the membership desk, because the volunteers cannot release keys without proof of payment. Plots unclaimed by Sunday will return to the waiting list.

The museum's night event sold out faster than ever, and the guest list stretches past four hundred names. Catering wants final numbers by Wednesday, because the kitchen orders ingredients two days ahead. Stevo, who coordinates the volunteers, has asked everyone to confirm shifts through the scheduling app rather than by email, so the door teams stay balanced.
The printer lease expires in six weeks, and the vendor renewal quote arrived twenty percent above last year. Finance wants two competing quotes before sign-off by Hocine.

Montane forwarded the forestry notice to the hiking group: the red trail is rerouted away from the creek crossing until the footbridge passes inspection, and the detour adds twenty minutes. Leaders should count heads at both junctions, because phone signal drops in the valley and several members missed the last turn during the March walk.
The venue moved the award dinner to the smaller hall after the fire inspection cut capacity. Ms. Zychlinsky asked everyone to confirm attendance by noon so catering can adjust.

The trainee roster swap for the night shift caused confusion at handover, since two names were swapped in the logbook. Payroll noticed the mismatch when overtime hours pointed at the wrong department, and the correction request was attached by Chandrakumar.

The charity auction closed with record bids, and the organizer thread covers three weeks of planning. Attached below is the donor list with pick-up times for every winning item, plus the receipt templates for tax purposes. Volunteers should collect unsold lots on Saturday morning and store them in the locked cabinet until the next fundraiser.
Best regards,
Krist
Franklin forwarded the pool booking confirmation, but the date shows the wrong month. The office replied that the system cannot amend bookings, so a fresh request is needed.

The rehearsal schedule changed after the soloist cancelled, and the conductor wants the second violins ready. Ms. Ramitha asked the section leaders to circulate updated parts before Thursday, because the old copies number the bars differently and the page turns confuse everyone mid-run.

The customs paperwork for the exhibition crates came back with three forms stamped in the wrong place, and the courier cannot release the shipment until the corrections clear. The gallery secretary reprinted everything, attached the original invoices, and booked a priority slot at the depot. The corrected bundle was checked page by page and countersigned by Sivakumar Gervasio.

The team lunch moved to the bistro because the cafeteria closes early on Fridays. Forward the menu choices before ten.
Cheers,
Altan

Tidjane forwarded the maintenance notice about the water shutoff, which affects the annex between eight and noon while the pressure valve is replaced. Staff should fill kettles and bottles beforehand, and the laboratory fridges must stay closed throughout to protect the samples.

The archive box labels faded badly during the basement flood scare, and half the index cards no longer match the shelf order. A volunteer team spent Saturday relabeling the oldest boxes with waterproof tags, while the reading room stayed closed. Mr. Ruthiranathan asked for a finding aid so visitors can locate the microfilm reels without handling the folders.
The boarding passes list the old terminal after last week's gate shuffle, so allow extra time for the shuttle. The updated itinerary was resent by Gacem.

The supplier thread grew long, so here is the short version: frames arrive Thursday, glazing follows Monday, and the site must be clear of scaffolding by then. Any objection should reach the thread before Wednesday noon.
Regards,
Otremba

Ajlena forwarded the choir timetable with one correction: the Thursday rehearsal moves to the chapel because the school hall hosts an exam, and the Sunday evensong now starts fifteen minutes later. Car sharing is arranged for the regional performance, with the minibus leaving the square at six.
The photocopier contract renews automatically unless someone cancels by Friday. Ms. Nienborg drafted the cancellation email for approval, since usage has halved.

The venue visit raised doubts because the freight lift stops below the landing and the ramp angle looks steep for the piano. The organizer asked the venue for measurements and will keep the date, subject to a final check by Sachse.
Ms. Ferzada opened the quarterly review by tabling the insurance renewal, which rose eight percent despite no claims. The committee deferred the decision until the broker explains the loading.

The safety walkthrough found the laboratory eyewash station blocked by a storage rack, and the fire door propped open with a chair. Vethaak volunteered to move the rack before Friday and label the assembly point, which the inspector flagged during the last visit.

The stock take revealed a shortage of connector adapters in the west store, despite the ledger showing a healthy surplus. The recount confirmed the gap, and purchasing traced it to a delivery logged twice in September. The team agreed to photograph deliveries and reconcile the ledger weekly. Action owner for the new checklist: Cherno Dashmir Markandan.

Minutes of the Tuesday welfare committee are drafted and stored in the shared folder. Members have until Thursday to suggest edits.
Thanks,
Gjastin

Mr. Madár reported that the licensing audit is due in six weeks and two departments have not returned their evidence packs. The committee set a deadline of Friday, after which the secretary will chase outstanding items daily and escalate delays to the directorate.

The grants subcommittee reviewed four applications and shortlisted two for the final round, with funding sufficient for only one project. Cutaia noted that the community garden proposal includes matched volunteer hours, which strengthens its case against the heritage trail plan, and asked whether leftover equipment budget could cover the insurance gap. The vote lands next month.
The roof report recommends replacing flashing within two years, not immediately. The board voted to save toward the full repair, with costs to be gathered by Kanenthiraraj.

Here are the action points from the parking review: repaint the bay numbers, fix the motorcycle gate spring, and send the survey link to all residents. The caretaker requested paint samples before any purchase.
Cheers,
Bisan

Ms. Johannita tabled the catering tender with a warning: the cheapest bid omits the vegan counter, which caused complaints at previous events. The committee compared the three offers line by line, agreed that the mid-priced bid covers dietary needs without exceeding budget, and instructed the secretary to notify the winning vendor and the unsuccessful bidders before publication.
The nursery needs two parents for the trip to the farm museum. Almeyra offered to drive if the minibus seat count stays within the insurance limit.

The hire committee reviewed the shortlist twice and could not separate the two final candidates on paper. Both gave strong answers, so the panel agreed to call referees before offering the post to anyone, with reference calls to start on Monday under Rajeev.

The workshop filled both sessions within a day, and the waiting list reached forty names by Friday. Trainers suggested running a third session in the annex, provided the projector is moved and chairs are borrowed from the library. The organizer will confirm room access with facilities and publish the extra date once the budget line is approved.
Regards,
Magfire
Ms. Polach called the session to order and asked for silence on the street-noise petition, which now carries three hundred signatures and goes to the council on Thursday.

The archive digitization pilot scanned four hundred pages in a week, but the metadata template proved too slow for handwritten entries. Medija Renáta demonstrated a faster tab layout that cuts keystrokes by half, and the panel approved a two-week trial on the parish registers.

The playgroup equipment check found three ride-on toys with cracked wheels and a climbing frame missing two bolts, so the affected items were quarantined immediately. Parents were informed through the notice board, and replacements were priced from the catalogue. The treasurer confirmed the reserve fund covers the cost, and the order was placed the same afternoon under Kounache.

Daudré-Vignier: heads up, the shared calendar shows the studio booked for the podcast recording until nine, so the morning class moves to the annex. Bring your own mats because the annex cupboard is still locked, and reply here once you see this.

Update from the school chat: the bake sale raised more than last year, and the head wants ideas for spending the surplus before the term ends. Several parents suggested new goalposts, others want shading for the courtyard, and Ms. Metiner offered to ask the supplier for quotes on both so the committee can compare prices properly at the meeting.
Does anyone know why the studio key sits in the wrong box? The evening class almost started late. Sort it out before the landlord visits, please, says Nazik.

Team, the courier needs a signature at the front desk for tomorrow's delivery of the exhibition panels, and the desk is unmanned after five. Whoever is last out, please sign for the crates and store the paperwork in the tray.
--
Zuccali

Kukri, the climbing wall slot moved: the centre doubled evening prices without telling members, and the booking page shows the old tariff. A few of us complained at the desk, and the manager promised a discount code by Friday, but nobody has seen it. Check the group thread before paying, and keep your receipts until the credit lands.
The group chat exploded over the parking charge: two hours free, then a fortune. Ms. Adithya suggested car sharing for the late shift instead. The stewards agreed.

Reminder for the costume team: the dress rehearsal starts at six, not seven, because the theatre locks the lobby early. Hats and props go in the labelled boxes, and the stage manager wants everything staged before the curtain run, says DelToro.

Changing the rota for next week: the venue confirmed the late licence covers Friday but not Saturday, so the acoustic night moves a day earlier. Performers should bring their own cables, since the house box went missing after the last event, and the sound check runs from four.
Regards,
Caraco
Akhilesh, the group order for the team hoodies closes tonight. Sizes run small, and the seller wants one payment, so add your choice to the list before nine.

The book club poll closed with a tie between the two shortlist titles, and the moderator flipped a coin live on the call. Maneint Selouiti suggested reading both back to back and skipping the December meeting, which the group accepted without another vote.

The delivery chat went quiet after the van breakdown near the bridge, and the pizza dough for the evening service sat in a depot for two hours. The supervisor arranged a rescue run with ice packs, salvaging half the order, and the menu switched to the dry-aged range. A refund was offered to every preorder customer by Perinparasa.

The chess ladder resets on Monday, and the club room key moves to the custodian's office. Post your match results before the deadline.
Cheers,
Ilmari

Destinobles, the venue changed the entry rules: no glass bottles on the terrace after the incident, and bags bigger than a rucksack go in the lockers. The team should arrive early for the sound check, because the lift queue is slow on event nights.

The night-shift handover moved to the smaller room after complaints about noise near the ward, and the board with the magnetic rota came along. Mr. Stambolija asked for a printed backup, because the projector remote vanished again and nobody enjoys copying the grid by hand at midnight when the system card reader misbehaves.
Anyone have the projector remote from the attic office? The film night is tomorrow and the spare batteries died. Bring it to the studio, please, says Chatzi.

Mr. Vijendra, this is a reminder from the physiotherapy clinic for the assessment booked this Thursday at half past three. Please arrive fifteen minutes early to complete the intake form, wear loose clothing for the movement tests, and bring the referral letter from your doctor. If the slot no longer suits, call the front desk before Wednesday.
The visa interview moved to the ninth floor because of renovation work. Jovien should bring the original invitation letter and two photocopies, plus the fee receipt.

The dental clinic confirmed the follow-up for the crown fitting, and the appointment now includes a scan that adds ten minutes. Patients should avoid chewing on the treated side beforehand, and any rescheduling must reach the desk within two working days, addressed to Vlasceanu.

Reminder for the piano examination on Saturday: the candidate should warm up in the practice corridor from nine, because the jury runs to time and late arrivals forfeit the slot. Bring two printed copies of the programme and pencils for the examiner. The results are posted the same evening, and certificates follow by post.
Regards,
Gajendran
Ms. Grundisch, the allergy test is confirmed for Tuesday at ten. Stop antihistamines three days before, and bring your previous results folder to the clinic.

The driving test centre moved the meeting point for the practical exam: candidates gather at the side gate while the forecourt is resurfaced. Endric Muscetta should check in with the invigilator twenty minutes early and display the provisional licence on the dashboard.

The allergy clinic moved the patch-test reading to the following week because the consultant attends a conference, and the stickers must stay dry in the meantime. Patients receive a text with the slot, and the receptionist asks everyone to confirm within three days so the schedule holds. Unconfirmed bookings are released automatically, per policy countersigned by Miwa.

Your tune-up is booked for Thursday at the workshop on Mill Lane. Collect the bike the same day, since storage is limited.
Best,
Castrejon

Ms. Kelbas, the notary office confirmed the property signing for Friday morning and asks that both parties bring original identity documents. The bank representative arrives at ten, so the meeting starts promptly, and any delay beyond thirty minutes requires a fresh slot.

The cardiologist's office sent the preparation sheet for the stress test: light breakfast three hours before, no caffeine since the previous evening, comfortable shoes for the treadmill, and the usual medications unless the doctor says otherwise. Memoglu should bring the blood results from the lab, because the consultant wants to compare enzyme levels before Friday's session.
The passport renewal session is fully booked until April. Emergency slots open on Mondays, and the queue forms early outside the registry, according to Rondineau.

Note about the physio follow-up: the therapist wants the exercise diary completed daily, including the pain scores, and the session includes taping for the shoulder. Please park behind the annex, because the front yard is reserved for deliveries on Thursdays.
Kind regards,
Vaniet

Mr. Luk, the surveyor will inspect the flat on Wednesday between nine and eleven, checking the damp marks along the kitchen wall and the crack above the balcony door. Please clear the counter and move the bookshelf away from the affected corner, since photographs need a clear view of every stain.
The mower service is due before the season starts. Henri-Louis should drop the machine at the depot by Friday, with the blade sharpened and the oil label attached.

The audiology clinic rescheduled the hearing-aid fitting because the technician attends training, and the new slot includes a longer orientation about cleaning and storage. Patients should bring the purchase invoice, since the file transfer between branches is slow, confirmed by Héli.
Bruchez — membership 0447, renewal due in October, locker 12, emergency contact listed, attends morning classes only, payment by monthly card, notes say prefers the quiet studio.

Building registry, entry 210: unit 14, annual inspection passed, smoke alarms replaced in March by Claude-André Liew, balcony railing scheduled for repainting. The occupancy certificate was transferred in spring, with the fee receipt filed and countersigned.

Incident record 77: a shelf collapsed in the stockroom at 21:40 on Tuesday, damaging six cartons of glass jars and blocking the fire exit for nine minutes. Staff cleared the aisle and logged the loss, the carrier confirmed transit insurance applies to two cartons, and the remainder was written off under the store policy, entry closed by Gafure.

Visitor pass 118, issued for the archive floor, valid until six, escort required beyond the reading room for the maps.
Regards,
Kayisoglu

Provoliu, file 3412: roof estimate requested after the storm damage survey, photographs attached, deductible confirmed with the insurer, contractor quotes pending from two firms, and the policyholder prefers repairs before the rainy season starts.

Equipment checkout log, item 62: two ladders and a paint sprayer borrowed for the courtyard renovation on the eleventh, returned within the agreed window. Ms. Pedemonte inspected the sprayer filter before release and noted a cracked nozzle cover, which was replaced from the spares box, and the deposit was refunded without deduction the following morning.
Swim pass 88 renewed for the winter term, locker 214 reassigned because of the pipe works, direct debit updated. Form completed and filed by Pika.

Consent form 55: the photographs from the workshop may be used on the community board and the newsletter, but never with surnames or contact details. The withdrawal clause was explained in plain language before signature.
Regards,
Gagiu

Jaouada, intake form 202: utility account opened at the south flat, meter reading submitted on the first, paper billing declined in favour of email, and the vulnerable-user register box left blank at your instruction. The inspection visit from the network operator is compulsory before the tariff switch, so please confirm any access constraints in the reply section.
Lost property, tag 33: grey umbrella, monogrammed handle, found near platform two on the fourth. Ms. Lívio verified the claim ticket before release.

Complaint form 112: the delivery arrived a day late and the cold chain was broken, because the van's refrigerator failed on the ring road. The supplier offered a replacement batch, and the supermarket rejected the goods, with forms signed by Mokuna-Trouet.

Insurance claim 190: the burst pipe damaged the hallway floor and part of the kitchen plaster on the second. Emergency repairs were carried out the same evening, the plumber's invoice and photographs attached, and the assessor booked a visit for the twentieth. Two furniture items are listed for restoration, and all paperwork sits under the reference.
Thanks,
Nagi
Inti Scaccabarozzi, permit 77: scaffolding on the north elevation until mid-month, no street occupancy overnight, notice board displayed at the site entrance, and the fee paid by card.

Medical file 512: the vaccination record shows two missing boosters, the allergy page lists penicillin, and the next review is booked for the autumn. Ms. Gahbauer countersigned the consent section after the translator call, so the appointment stands.

Keys log 9: the observatory dome key was taken out on the twelfth and returned the next morning, matching the scheduled maintenance window. The sign-out sheet shows a legible signature, and the caretaker confirmed the padlock was oiled. Two warning notices about the wind limit are posted inside the hatch, with the updated log sheet filed by Stefaniia.
Bukatz | stall 14 | Saturdays only | wool and felt kits | card reader broken, cash preferred | cover charge paid | tables 2 and 3 | early setup from seven | tea urn provided by the hall

Rota for the festival weekend | Friday gates 16:00, brief the stewards, first-aid tent open | Saturday parade marshal at 10, Mysyrowicz on radios, two water stations, litter sweep at dusk | Sunday quiet teardown, return kit, count the floats | notes spare batteries in the cabin, cash box with the treasurer
Cleaning rota, week 41 | kitchen counters, bins, floor | corridor vacuum, skirting | stairwell rail polish | bin day Thursday | duty pair shift lead and Corbin

Shopping list for the repair day | sealant, two brushes, masking tape, gloves | drill bits, sandpaper medium and fine | tea, biscuits, milk | budget under forty | pickup at the depot at eight
Thanks,
Uksini

Ezekiel | plot 12 | beans, peas, and two rows of kale | watering rota Tuesday evenings | compost delivered in spring, half a tonne | shared tools locked in the shed | waiting list for the neighbouring plot | committee contact via the notice board | harvest lunch scheduled for September, contributions welcome
Seating plan | table one family, six places | table two Karman and colleagues from the depot | table three neighbours | overflow at the back for choir

Reading list for the history circle | sources on the canal era | two maps requested from the county archive | newspaper microfilm reserved until Thursday | copies to be made at cost | final slot on the shelf reserved for Khairy

Expedition manifest | tents 3, stove 2, fuel bottles 4 | first-aid kit restocked, blister plasters added | maps laminated, compass checked | water filter serviced, spare element packed | route cards with the warden | weather window confirmed by radio | group kit bag labelled and weighed
Cheers,
Saredi
de Meurichy | row 5 | tulip bulbs, 60 pieces | bed prepared with sharp sand | planting depth three hand-widths | label and date recorded

Plant watering schedule | ferns twice weekly, mist the leaves | succulents monthly, soak and drain | peace lily weekly, filter the water | Tsevelmaa covers Fridays | the weekend shifts rotate alphabetically | orchid food arrives in spring

Archive index, drawer D | lantern slides 1880 to 1920 | glass plates fragile, cotton gloves required | inventory sheet updated after each loan | projector bulbs stored separately from the slides | loan slips countersigned by the registrar | annual dust check due in November | key holder recorded at the front desk as Marny

Trail register, checkpoint 3 | water refilled | bandages restocked | logbook stamped | rope coiled and hung
Best,
Keegan

Ms. Agnes | table 8 | glaze samples fired in the last kiln | new shelves ordered | slip cast tests cracked in two places | electric wheel booked for Thursday | clay store key returned to the office | studio fee settled by card

Volunteer rota, winter fair | gate one two people from opening | gift wrap stall rotating pairs | tombola cash box, float counted at handover | kitchen food hygiene certificate required | Maria-Franca coordinates the raffle prizes | Santa grotto photographer cleared, background check filed | lost child point marked at the first-aid tent
Boxing class register | evening group, cap of sixteen | sparring on Wednesdays | mouthguards compulsory | insurance waiver filed by Gattous

Gkamtzas here — quick heads up about saturday: the coach leaves at seven sharp, not seven thirty like the newsletter said, so bring ur own breakfast or go hungry till the venue. Kits go in the big blue bin, definately not in the changing room, and the subs bench is coverred if anyone cant make it after all.
the landlord finaly fixed the boiler but left mud everywhere lol. Ms. Brendebach wants photos before we clean it up, dont touch anything yet

were meeting at the courts at six, not the gym, cause the floor got waxed or somthing. bring the good balls this time, the old ones bounced like potatoes, and text the group when your leaving so we no who shows, says Josset

so the party is definately happening friday, the room got booked eventualy after the mixup with the dates, ask in the group for details. anyway theme is bad hats, bring snacks that dont need forks, and the speaker works again after jiggling the cable so music is sorted. printers still broken tho
--
Seiffer
Fedora Cugalj Acquavia Mcneil says the bake sale raised heaps, thanx everyone who baked! leftover cakes go to the shelter tomorow, meet at the gate at noon

the trail run got moved cause of the mud, new start is the old mill, and Ms. Doxakis is bringing her famous flapjacks for the finish line. bring water cause the tap at the mill stoped working last week, dont ask me why

so basicaly the plan changed again, the ferry got cancelled and now were driving, which means leaving ridiculus early. pack light cause the boot is full of camping gear already, and someone remeber to bring the tickets this time. i already asked my neighbour to feed the cat, whos bringing snacks? that would be Gauvain

the quiz night got moved to the back room cause of the bingo upstairs, bring your own pens and arrive early
cheers,
Alysia

Birogul here — dont forget the keys for the hall are with the caretaker now, the old box got removed cause it kept jamming. also the projector remote is definately lost for good this time, bring a clicker if you have one

so the landlord sent the repair guy finaly, he fixed the window latch in like ten minutes but said the frame is roting from the inside and needs a full replacement befor winter. he left a quote which Ms. Kameri fotographed on her phone cause our printer died, and the agency wants it emaied by friday
the concert got moved indoors cause of rain, doors open at seven tommorow. save me a spot at the front, text me when you arrive, says Langle

so the group project got pushed a week, no need to panic about the slides tommorow. meet at the library tho cause the book we need is on reserve and someone has to copy the tables befor the desk closes
--
Church

Diana-Carmen here, finaly some good news: the insurance payed out for the flooded cellar, so we can replace the dryer and the shelfs that got ruined. were keeping the dehumidifier running till the weekend just in case, and the electrician comes tuesday to check the sockets near the boiler cause the assesor flagged them in his report
the fixie got a flat, third time this month, so Ms. Sovran is takeing it to the shop tomorow. pray they dont keep it long like before

were moving the jam session to the atic cause the drums echo downstairs now, bring ur own mugs cause the kitchen ones disapeared ages ago. also someone actualy fixed the heater, miracle, so no more freezing, thanks to Spasikov
De Baere Howatson Bonsma won the regional beekeeping prize for the second straight year, after judges praised the low-water method and the clarity of the honey labels.

The neighbourhood bakery reopened three weeks after the fire, with new ovens donated and a queue stretching past the corner. Jaffrés, who runs the shop with two apprentices, credited the customers who prepaid vouchers during the closure and promised a free bread week.

The council approved the riverside path extension after a two-year campaign, overruling the parking objections and setting the works for spring. The funding combines a heritage grant with the parish reserve, and the footbridge commission goes to the local firm that restored the mill gates. The petition that carried the vote was coordinated by Schilbach.

The orchard harvest doubled thanks to the new beehives, and the pressing day drew a record crowd. Full report attached.
Regards,
Ashvitha

Mr. DeLozier broke the club record at the winter swim, finishing the lake circuit eleven seconds ahead of the previous mark set in the nineties. Spectators lined the jetty, and the timekeeper confirmed the result with two stopwatches before the award was announced.

The village shop avoided closure after a community buyout raised the deposit in under a month, with pledges coming from three neighbouring parishes and a matched grant from the county fund. Mattie, who chaired the steering group, said the shop will stock regional produce on consignment, and that the post counter stays open while the licence transfer clears.
The brass band raised the remaining roof funds with a sponsored silence, of all things, lasting a full weekend. The final pledge was collected by Chaniotis.

The rowing club lost its boathouse key box to the flood, and the replacements took a fortnight to arrive from the supplier. Members improvised with a combination lock, and the damage claim was filed with photographs and the original invoice.
Regards,
Tatham

Ms. Monterosa denied rumours that the theatre would close, pointing to the refurbished seats and the new box office system installed last month. Ticket sales for the spring season exceeded the target by a fifth, helped by the schools programme that brings matinee audiences every fortnight, and the board approved the repainting during the summer break.
The stained-glass window returned to the chapel after eight months of restoration, and the protective grille finally sits flush. Dioum unveiled it before a small crowd of donors.

The flood barrier test passed on Saturday for the first time since the pumps were upgraded, holding the simulated surge for the hour. Volunteers manned the sluice gates while engineers monitored the telemetry, and the certificate was signed at the scene by Jakoubi.

The heritage railway carried more passengers this season than in any year since the volunteers took over the branch line, helped by the autumn steam gala and the new cycle carriage. The volunteer roster now covers every weekend without gaps, and the workshop restored a second carriage to working order.
Kind regards,
Odeta Stawarz Bagdjian
Mr. Banditelli donated the archive of photographs spanning fifty years of the fishing fleet, and the museum opened a dedicated room for the collection last month.

The allotment committee banned hoses for the summer after the meter showed record consumption, asking plot holders to water before nine instead. Tavaretti collected rain barrels at a discount from the reclamation yard and offered spares to neighbours, which softened the grumbling considerably.

The night market returned to the square after two cancelled seasons, and stallholders reported steady trade despite the cold snap. The organising group credited the scouts who cleared the ice at dawn and the bakery that kept the mulled cider flowing. The licence for next year was secured before the gates closed, witnessed by Eyoub.
